paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Batra 30a: one man said to another, “I am selling you all the property of the house of Bar Sisin.” They came before Rav Nachman, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson paragraph at Bava Batra 30a has the sale of all property of the house of Bar Sisin and the parties coming before fully written Rav Nachman. The supplied abbreviation and “etc.” remain the source’s abridgment; the rest of the legal discussion is not added.
